items.title: microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners

items.title: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
items.author: Significant-Gravitas
items.rawContent: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
items.summary: AutoGPT 是一个开源的自主AI代理框架，旨在降低AI应用与开发门槛，支持用户基于LLM构建可自主规划、执行和迭代的任务系统。
items.summaryEn: AutoGPT is an open-source autonomous AI agent framework designed to democratize AI usage and development, enabling users to build LLM-powered agents that plan, execute, and iterate tasks independently.
items.titleEn: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT

items.title: NousResearch/hermes-agent
items.author: NousResearch
items.rawContent: The agent that grows with you
items.summary: NousResearch/hermes-agent 是一个开源的、可扩展的智能体框架，旨在随用户需求演进，支持动态工具调用与上下文自适应。该项目提供代码仓库、配置示例和基础文档，便于开发者快速集成与定制。
items.summaryEn: NousResearch/hermes-agent is an open-source, extensible agent framework designed to evolve with user needs, supporting dynamic tool use and context-aware adaptation. The repository includes code, configuration examples, and foundational documentation for developer integration and customization.
items.titleEn: NousResearch/hermes-agent

items.title: The Query Was Still a Lie. The Tool Call Told the Truth.
items.author: Self-Correcting Systems
items.rawContent: This continues the Self-Correcting Systems research on why relevance alone is insufficient for agent...
items.summary: 本文探讨AI智能体系统中“查询失真”与“工具调用真实”之间的张力，指出仅依赖相关性评估不足以保障推理可靠性，并延续了自校正系统（Self-Correcting Systems）的前沿研究脉络。
items.summaryEn: This article examines the tension between 'query distortion' and 'tool-call truthfulness' in AI agent systems, arguing that relevance alone is insufficient for reliable reasoning—a continuation of cutting-edge research on self-correcting systems.
items.titleEn: The Query Was Still a Lie. The Tool Call Told the Truth.

items.title: Your Agent Failed in Prod. Good Luck Reproducing It.
items.author: Tisha Chawla
items.rawContent: Why LLM agents are so hard to reproduce, why some of that nondeterminism is a feature you should not remove, and how record and replay gets you the one thing you actually need.
items.summary: 本文探讨了LLM智能体在生产环境中难以复现的根本原因，指出部分不确定性实为设计特性，并介绍了“记录与回放”（record-and-replay）这一实用调试方法，帮助开发者高效定位和修复问题。
items.summaryEn: This article explains why LLM agents are notoriously difficult to reproduce in production—highlighting that some nondeterminism is intentional and beneficial—and introduces record-and-replay as a practical, actionable debugging technique to capture and diagnose real-world agent failures.
items.titleEn: Your Agent Failed in Prod. Good Luck Reproducing It.

items.title: huggingface/transformers

items.summaryEn: Hugging Face Transformers is a widely adopted open-source library offering thousands of pre-trained models and a unified API for inference and training across text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks.
items.titleEn: huggingface/transformers

items.title: Gemma 4 12B: A unified, encoder-free multimodal model
items.author: rvz
items.rawContent: Gemma 4 12B: A unified, encoder-free multimodal model
items.summary: 本文介绍Gemma 4 12B——一款统一的、无需独立编码器的多模态大模型，强调其架构创新与跨模态能力。该模型尚未开源或商用，目前仅以技术概念形式在社区披露。
items.summaryEn: This post introduces Gemma 4 12B—a unified, encoder-free multimodal large language model—highlighting its architectural novelty and cross-modal capabilities. It is currently disclosed as a conceptual/technical announcement with no public release or implementation details.
items.titleEn: Gemma 4 12B: A unified, encoder-free multimodal model

items.title: I Built an AI-Powered Meeting Platform From Scratch — Here’s How It Actually Works
items.author: Anupam Kumar
items.rawContent: A complete breakdown of Hoovik: WebRTC signaling, distributed Node.js with Redis, real-time emotion...

items.title: ollama/ollama

items.title: I built a vulnerable app and spent $1,500 seeing if LLMs could hack it
items.author: jc4p
items.rawContent: I built a vulnerable app and spent $1,500 seeing if LLMs could hack it
items.summary: 作者构建了一个存在安全漏洞的Web应用，并投入1500美元测试主流大语言模型（LLM）是否能自主发现并利用这些漏洞，结果揭示了当前LLM在真实渗透测试任务中的能力边界与局限性。
items.summaryEn: The author built a deliberately vulnerable web application and spent $1,500 testing whether mainstream LLMs could autonomously discover and exploit its security flaws—revealing practical limitations and emergent capabilities of LLMs in real-world penetration testing scenarios.
items.titleEn: I built a vulnerable app and spent $1,500 seeing if LLMs could hack it

items.summaryEn: This article explains how to safely run AI coding agents using Docker sandboxing—covering container configuration, privilege restrictions, and network isolation—to prevent unauthorized host system access or damage.
items.titleEn: Run AI Coding Agents Safely with Docker Sandboxes

items.title: Uber's $1,500/month AI limit is a useful signal for AI tool pricing
items.author: pdyc

items.summary: 本文讨论优步对AI工具（如Claude Code）设置每月1500美元使用上限的商业决策，将其视为AI企业服务定价趋势的重要信号，反映大公司对AI成本管控的现实考量。
items.summaryEn: This piece analyzes Uber's imposition of a $1,500/month cap on AI tool usage (e.g., Claude Code) as a strategic cost-control measure and interprets it as an indicative signal for broader enterprise AI pricing dynamics.

items.title: Show HN: Uruky (EU-based Kagi alternative) now has Image Search and URL Rewrites
items.author: BrunoBernardino
items.rawContent:
You can get a 2h free trial by solving a proof-of-work captcha when topping up your account for the first time.

If you'd like to learn more, an independent interview was posted a couple of weeks ago [1], and the FAQ [2] has a lot of information as well.

For the source code sharing, we've talked with lawyers and are inclined to no longer require the NDA/NCC for privacy reasons shared with us before (signing requires identification), but instead use a source-available permissive
items.summary: Uruky 是一款总部位于欧盟的新型搜索引擎，作为 Kagi 的替代品，新上线了图像搜索和 URL 重写功能，并提供通过工作量证明验证码获取的 2 小时免费试用。其源代码采用源可用（source-available）许可模式，已放弃强制签署 NDA/NCC 的要求。
items.summaryEn: Uruky is an EU-based search engine positioned as a Kagi alternative, newly launching image search and URL rewriting features; it offers a 2-hour free trial via proof-of-work CAPTCHA and has shifted to a source-available licensing model—dropping mandatory NDA/NCC agreements for privacy reasons.
items.titleEn: Show HN: Uruky (EU-based Kagi alternative) now has Image Search and URL Rewrites

items.title: Do Text Edits Generalize to Visual Generation? Benchmarking Cross-Modal Knowledge Editing in UMMs
items.author: Xin Gao
items.rawContent: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose multimodal intelligence. As they are deployed in real-world applications, effectively updating internal knowledge becomes critical. While knowledge editing has matured for text-only models, it remains unclear whether edits that successfully modify textual outputs also transfer to image generation in UMMs. To study this question, we introduce UniKE, the first benchmark for cross-modality knowledge editing in
items.summary: 本文提出UniKE基准，首次系统评估统一多模态模型（UMMs）中跨模态知识编辑的有效性，探究文本知识编辑能否泛化至图像生成任务。
items.summaryEn: This paper introduces UniKE, the first benchmark for evaluating cross-modal knowledge editing in unified multimodal models (UMMs), investigating whether text-based knowledge edits generalize to visual generation outputs.
items.titleEn: Do Text Edits Generalize to Visual Generation? Benchmarking Cross-Modal Knowledge Editing in UMMs
